name: S2M2
plain: A transformer-based stereo family in four sizes (S, M, L, XL). Non-commercial licence.
summary: S2M2 (Min et al. 2025): multi-resolution transformer with optimal-transport matching; also outputs confidence and occlusion maps.

papers.title: S2M2: Scalable Stereo Matching Model for Reliable Depth Estimation

limitations: At 994x1482 portable S2M2-S is about as fast as the original code and allocates slightly more memory; use kernels for speed and memory.
task_io: Input: a rectified left / right image pair. Output: a disparity map (pixels, left view).
